slides.headline:
The house is the photograph.
The drinks are the memory.
slides.subline: Gong-Gan, Anguk-dong — a bar inside a restored hanok, No. 74 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026

slides.label:
Gong-Gan's place on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 —
it sat at No. 89 on the 2024 edition
slides.note: Asia's 50 Best Bars published its extended 51-100 list for 2026 on 14 July 2026, with four Seoul bars on it: Gong-Gan at 74, Charles H. at 87, Le Chamber at 88 and Soko at 89. Gong-Gan was not a new entry — it had already appeared at No. 89 in 2024.

slides.title:
What the room
is built around

items.t: A courtyard, not a bar counter
items.d: The hanok's central courtyard is the centrepiece of the interior, and Seoul's own tourism office notes the space reads differently by day and by night
50 Best Discovery describes cream tones, wooden furniture and natural accents — restraint rather than the dark-wood speakeasy look
The drinks are drawn from the team's own recollections. Si-Jang is an ode to the local food market; Azalea recalls drawing honey from flowers in a garden
The bar works to an 'upcycling cocktails' approach, putting leftover cocktail ingredients to use in the bar food

slides.title:
A hanok bar that isn't
selling the hanok.
slides.body:
Seoul has a small cluster of bars inside traditional Korean houses now, and most of them lean on the building: the beams, the tiled roof, the courtyard at night. Gong-Gan has all of that, a few minutes' walk from Anguk Station in Bukchon, and it is genuinely the first thing anyone photographs.

The menu is pulling in a different direction. Its cocktails are named and built after specific memories belonging to the people making them — a childhood trip to the neighbourhood market, honey taken from flowers in a garden. That is a harder thing to sell to a visitor than a tiled roof and a courtyard, because it can't be explained by the room.

The housekeeping matches. Leftover ingredients are folded back into the bar snacks rather than binned, and the bar has run donation and accessibility events with other local venues. It reads as a place more interested in what happens inside the hanok than in the hanok itself — which may be why it has stayed on Asia's list across editions.

items.d: A quiet alley in Anguk-dong, roughly 470m from Anguk Station Exit 1 on Subway Line 3
Last order 01:30, per Seoul's official English travel guide. Worth confirming, as late-night hours change often
The average drink price on its 50 Best Discovery listing. Ask about Si-Jang and Azalea, the two the listing singles out

items.t: Reservations and groups accepted — and dogs
items.d: Listed as pet-friendly, and it hosts visiting guest bartenders. Instagram is @gong_gan_anguk; the Discovery listing gives +82 2 723 3664

Taste is always personal.

caption:
A hanok in Bukchon, and a cocktail menu made of other people's childhoods.

Gong-Gan sits at No. 74 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026. Its drinks are built from the team's own memories — a market trip, honey from a garden — and leftover ingredients go back into the bar snacks.

Research, not a visit. Hours and prices as of September 2026, and taste is personal.

Sources in the last slide. Save it for Seoul.
